routes.summary: Resolve https://doi.org/<DOI> with curl and follow the landing page.
Download the arXiv PDF for the id.

routes.requires_note: Empty requires is not an omission. OpenAlex accepts a DOI, an arXiv id, or the title, and the title is on every request, so the route is not gated on a scheme.
routes.summary: Read OpenAlex open-access locations for the DOI, arXiv id, or title.
Read Unpaywall open-access locations for the DOI. The API contact address comes from UNPAYWALL_EMAIL and is not written into the manifest URL. See references/unpaywall.md.

routes.requires_note: Applies when an archive_record value starts with pmcid:. A PMCID learned from OpenAlex or Unpaywall in this same run is still fetched and logged. That discovery does not backfill an earlier route and does not, by itself, reopen a not_found issue.
routes.summary: Download the article PDF from the public PMC Open Access dataset over HTTPS. No cloud credentials. See references/pmc-oa.md.

routes.requires_note: any: a DOI or a canonical URL is enough. An arXiv id or an archive record alone does not select this route.
routes.summary: Open the publisher landing page with curl and follow its public download control.

routes.requires_note: any, not all: a DOI or a URL makes the route applicable. It does not require both. Call the availability API only when an earlier curl route followed an open-access https URL onto a redirect, an empty platform, or a page with no file. A DOI is listed because resolution is how that URL often appears. If no moved URL appeared, log one not_found row and say the API was not called. If complete bytes are already stored, skip this route and do not log it.
routes.summary: After an open-access link moves, query the Wayback availability API and fetch the raw file with the id_ URL.
Resolve a ProQuest publication number with the documented OpenURL syntax. Store the docview id, not a signed media URL.

routes.requires_note: any: a repository URL or an archive_record. A DOI alone does not select this route. A PMC Open Access package uses pmc-oa-package@1, not this id.
routes.summary: Fetch an institutional-repository record and its public file with curl.
Headless request of a UNL bepress Download URL.
CORE download for a verified CORE id. A headless 403 is bot mitigation, not a missing file.

routes.requires_note: The author string is on every request and is not a stable-id scheme. Run the route until complete bytes are stored. Log the page that was opened, as the worker skill describes.
routes.summary: Check the author or departmental page for a manuscript copy.

routes.requires_note: Not gated on a stable-id scheme. Run it only when a page answered with a bot check, a cookie wall, or a challenge and no route has complete bytes. If no challenge page remains, log one not_found row. If complete bytes are already stored, skip it and do not log it.
routes.summary: Open the record in a real browser, pass a cookie banner or bot check, and activate Download.

Browser Download on a UNL bepress record. The PDF may open inline in the viewer; save from the viewer. A bot check may be absent. The id stays unl-bepress-browser@1. A later procedure is a new id, such as unl-bepress-browser@2.

Browser Download PDF on a ProQuest docview page. A watermarked preview that is seen and not saved is needs_human, with error_category preview_only and obtained_bytes false. A saved preview is preview_only and keeps its hash.
